claims: Autumn Durald Arkapaw won the Academy Award for Best Cinematography for her work on Sinners at the 98th Academy Awards on March 15, 2026.
Autumn Durald Arkapaw was the first woman to win the Academy Award for Best Cinematography.

No woman had won the Academy Award for Best Cinematography in the previous 97 years of the Academy Awards.

Rachel Morrison was nominated for best cinematography for Mudbound in 2018.
Ari Wegner was nominated for best cinematography for The Power of the Dog in 2022.
Mandy Walker was nominated for best cinematography for Elvis in 2023.
